column5: A sturdy belt embedded with tiny crystal shards. Debris from the destroyed artifacts used by Firesong Druids at Embervine cave.
A staff of familiar-looking wood. Perhaps given, or taken, from one of the cursed in Faun's Thicket.

column4: A memento of your adventure together on Galen. A Khajiiti claw has carved the letter R on the base of this seasoned, well-used bow.
Scarred from the claws of many Faun spellcasters, this staff gives off a great deal of heat. Still connected in some way to the raging inferno beneath Galen.

column5: Enchanted with countless layers of protective magics, the druids of Galen ensure their champions are well cared for.
Castoff gloves from a former member of the Thieves Guild, the fingertips are still stained with lock oil and scarred from close calls with traps.
The regal colors of House Mornard once blazed on banners across the Systres. Now the house is in decline, their banners relegated to prominence in Vastyr.

column4: A simple but very fine piece of jewelry handed down through the generations from Bernique Mornard, a leader known as the mother of Vastyr.

The grip is notched by endless battles, while the blade is perfectly weighted; as flawless as the day it was forged. The sigil of House Mornard stands proudly at the hilt, a testament to its former owner.
Once worn by an acolyte of Druid King Kasorayn, this armor still bears the scars of fighting between the circles.
A trophy from the stores of the Firesong Circle. Still warm to the touch, the leaders of the circle knew endless magics now lost to zealotry and madness.
An ancient and rusted ring pitted with years of neglect. The faded sigil of the largely forgotten noble house Volorus dominates the face.
Slightly scorched in one or two places, this armor has a few cleverly sewn pockets perfectly sized for frog treats and toys.
Some small measure of the Gloomlantern's power dwell within these shoulders, causing fog to disperse around the wearer on a shrouded night.
A bit rusty and water worn from the dark seas around Galen, these gauntlets still bear the warmth of a loved one's touch.
A ring with a hidden compartment for spices. Filled with a signature concoction containing, among other things, Volcanic Reaper Peppers.

column5: Within the folds of this well-made hood you can still hear the whispers of Y'ffre's Chronicle echoing in your ears.
